business_problem: Corteva needed to evaluate billions of host-pathogen protein interactions and massive metabolomics datasets faster, but early-stage agricultural discovery pipelines were too computationally expensive to prioritize hypotheses quickly or refresh natural-product analyses often enough.
solution_summary: Corteva built two accelerated discovery workflows on NVIDIA software rather than treating crop research as one monolithic HPC job. For seed innovation, BioNeMo Boltz-2 NIM running on H200 GPUs predicts and verifies host-pathogen interactions, allowing the team to map disease-related protein networks in weeks instead of years while keeping biological fidelity. For crop protection, Corteva and the Wang Bioinformatics Lab rebuilt metabolomics analysis around RAPIDS cuML and cuVS so mass-spectral clustering, embeddings, and molecular networking can run at much higher cadence across growing natural-product libraries. Those two paths share a common pattern: proprietary biological data is filtered and prioritized on accelerated infrastructure first, then researchers use the resulting interaction maps and molecular networks to decide which candidates deserve scarce wet-lab and field resources downstream.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H200 GPUs
solution_components.role: Provide the compute used to benchmark and scale protein-interaction inference at production size.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA cuML
solution_components.role: Accelerates clustering in Corteva's natural-products metabolomics workflow.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA cuVS
solution_components.role: Speeds embedding and molecular-networking steps that prioritize crop-protection candidates.

data_flow: Pathogen and host-protein data are filtered and passed through BioNeMo Boltz-2 NIM on H200 GPUs to produce interaction maps for seed research. Separately, mass-spectrometry data enters a cuML and cuVS pipeline that clusters, embeds, and networks metabolites so researchers can prioritize natural-product candidates for crop-protection follow-up.
business_outcome: Corteva cut host-pathogen interaction mapping from years to weeks, made BioNeMo Boltz-2 NIM 4.15x faster than the open-source baseline, accelerated mass-spectral clustering 80x to 100x, and moved metabolomics runs from quarterly to monthly so more candidates can be evaluated earlier.
